items.title: Arborium: Tree-sitter code highlighting with Native and WASM targets
items.title_zh: Arborium：面向原生与 WASM 的 Tree-sitter 代码高亮

items.title: Rob Reiner has died
items.title_zh: 罗伯·莱纳去世
items.summary: Rob Reiner, a two-time Emmy winner and an Oscar nominee, and his wife Michele were discovered dead at their Brentwood residence; the LAPD says the couple's son Nick, arrested and booked for murder, caused their deaths.

items.title: Announcing the Beta release of ty
items.title_zh: ty 发布 Beta 版本
items.summary: Astral announced the beta release of ty, an extremely fast Python type checker and language server written in Rust and designed as an alternative to mypy, Pyright and Pylance.

items.title: SHARP, an approach to photorealistic view synthesis from a single image
items.title_zh: SHARP：从单张图像实现照片级真实感视角合成的方案
items.summary: The project page presents SHARP, an approach to photorealistic view synthesis from a single image.

items.title: Developers can now submit apps to ChatGPT
items.title_zh: 开发者现在可以向 ChatGPT 提交应用
items.summary: OpenAI announced that developers can now submit apps to ChatGPT.

items.title: Tesla reports another Robotaxi crash
items.title_zh: 特斯拉再报 Robotaxi 碰撞事故
items.summary: Tesla has reported yet another crash involving its Robotaxi fleet in Austin to NHTSA, Electrek reports.

items.title: GPT-5.2-Codex
items.title_zh: GPT-5.2-Codex

items.title: Your job is to deliver code you have proven to work
items.title_zh: 你的职责是交付你已证明可用的代码
items.summary: Simon Willison responds to a recurring anecdote in debates about AI-assisted software development, involving a junior engineer empowered by some class of tool, with the argument that a developer's job is to deliver code proven to work.

items.title: Noclip.website – A digital museum of video game levels
items.title_zh: Noclip.website——电子游戏关卡的数字博物馆
items.summary: A website described as a digital museum of video game levels.

items.title: Big GPUs don't need big PCs
items.title_zh: 大 GPU 未必需要大 PC
items.summary: Jeff Geerling notes that a Raspberry Pi offers only one PCIe Gen 3 lane for an external GPU, versus 16 PCIe Gen 5 lanes on a modern desktop, and questions the point of such a setup.

items.title: Show HN: HN Wrapped 2025 - an LLM reviews your year on HN
items.title_zh: Show HN：HN Wrapped 2025——用 LLM 回顾你的 HN 年度
items.summary: A developer built HN Wrapped 2025, which uses Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3 Pro Image to generate roasts, stats, a personalized 2035 HN front page, and an xkcd-style comic from a user's Hacker News activity.

items.title: How I protect my Forgejo instance from AI web crawlers

items.title: You’re not burnt out, you’re existentially starving
items.title_zh: 你不是倦怠，而是存在性饥饿
items.summary: The essay draws on Viktor Frankl's "Man's Search for Meaning" and the idea of an "existential vacuum" to reframe burnout as a lack of meaning.

items.title: Avoid UUID Version 4 Primary Keys in Postgres
items.title_zh: 在 Postgres 中避免使用 UUID v4 主键
items.summary: The post argues that PostgreSQL databases using UUID version 4 as the primary key type have often suffered poor performance and excessive I/O over the past decade.

items.title: SoundCloud has banned VPN access
items.title_zh: SoundCloud 封禁 VPN 访问
items.summary: SoundCloud has banned VPN access, according to a Reddit thread about the change.

items.title: Gemini 3 Pro vs. 2.5 Pro in Pokemon Crystal

items.title: Is Mozilla trying hard to kill itself?

items.title: Are Apple gift cards safe to redeem?

items.title: TikTok unlawfully tracks shopping habits and use of dating apps?
